# Asterwick Institute

The Asterwick Institute is an independent research institute that studies
coasts, moorland and the night sky. It runs six projects: [[project-heron]],
[[project-saltmarsh]], [[project-ember]], [[project-quill]],
[[project-lantern]] and [[project-wren]].

## Organisation

The institute works from four sites: [[kelmouth-site]], [[brask-station]],
[[tolvan-lab]] and the [[harrowgate-annex]]. Everyone who works here is
listed in the [[staff-directory]], and every instrument is listed in the
[[instrument-registry]].
